Clean robust blocky architectural forms, readable silhouette, no tiny spires, no thin fragile arches, no detached floating parts, no overhangs, no moat, no landscape, no ground plane texture beyond the fortress, no people, no creatures, no text, no labels, no watermark. Complete object framed with 10 percent margin, even neutral soft studio lighting, high fidelity stylized realistic game asset render. Pale weathered grey limestone, slightly cool tone, crisp block edges, every terrace floor clearly lighter than the walls.
